description: Golden retrieval set for regional-Japan travel evidence. Relevance is keyed on source titles rather than evidence ids, because ids are assigned at ingestion time and must not pin the dataset to one seeding run.
notes: Case classes: 'lexical' queries hinge on exact proper nouns a vector model blurs; 'semantic' queries describe an operational property in words the source never uses; 'mixed' needs both. The split exists so the comparison report can say *where* each retriever wins, not just that hybrid scores higher overall.
